breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the inconsistency. It explicitly instructed the user to apply the formula `n_v = N * exp(-Q_v / (k_B * T))`, which perpetuates the original error of mixing a molar energy (`Q_v` in J/mol) with the per-particle Boltzmann constant (`k_B`). This creates a unit mismatch in the exponential term, which was the core problem to be solved.
